description: The winapp CLI on PATH plus both plugins (winapp + winui) from microsoft/winappCli at a git ref: main by default, or any branch, tag, SHA or pull/N/head. Each ref is pinned to one commit per run. Pick refs in the dashboard, or use --agent cli-plus-skills@main,cli-plus-skills@my-branch.
prompt_addendum: The winapp CLI (`winapp`) is installed and on PATH. It creates, builds, runs, packages, signs and UI-tests Windows apps; run `winapp --help` to see its commands.
